title: Test Case Copilot
overview: An AI-assisted workflow that turns product requirements into reviewable test scenarios.
problem: Teams lose quality context when requirements move quickly.
solution: A guided agent extracts acceptance criteria, proposes edge cases, and keeps human review in control.

title: API Contract Guardian
overview: A lightweight agent for spotting breaking changes in API contracts before release.
problem: Unexpected API changes create avoidable integration failures.
solution: Automated specification comparison produces concise, actionable change reports in CI.
